sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) documents unauthorized credit card fraud identified on customer account C07987. On 2016-12-01 17:28:53, flagged transaction 3503878 for $99.92 was detected via online channel with an elevated risk score of 0.90. Graph analytics and multi-hop link expansion revealed that the transaction was associated with device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720', which was identified across 4 additional cardholder accounts (C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2). The cardholder, when contacted for transaction validation, confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of their physical card. The activity exhibits characteristics consistent with undocumented, where compromised credentials or card data were systematically exploited. Total cumulative fraudulent exposure across identified affected transactions (3503878) totals $99.92. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating actions by blocking card C07987-K2 for reissue, opening internal case HHG-019 in graph memory, and placing all connected card accounts under continuous surveillance per Bank Policy R2, R6, and regulatory guidelines.

stop_reason: Multi-hop graph link analysis identified coordinated device sharing across multiple cards with anonymous proxy routing. Stop condition met per R6 and R9.
